archetypes.name: White-Blue Flyers
archetypes.plan: Build around Air Servant: Hold the ground with defensive creatures and interaction while a concentrated suite of flyers wins overhead.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Control
archetypes.plan: Build around Opportunity: Trade one-for-one early, defend with high-toughness creatures, and win after card advantage exhausts the opponent.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Sacrifice
archetypes.plan: Build around Act of Treason: Feed expendable creatures to sacrifice outlets so death triggers and drain effects turn every trade into reach.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Creatures
archetypes.plan: Build around Advocate of the Beast: Play the largest efficient creature each turn and use removal or tricks to keep those threats attacking.

archetypes.name: Green-White Slivers
archetypes.plan: Build around Sentinel Sliver: Draft a critical mass of Slivers whose abilities stack, then attack once the whole team shares enough bonuses.
